expected_behaviour.format: mm:ss.cc from elapsed milliseconds; minutes may exceed 59 or saturate at 99:59.99 per stated rule
expected_behaviour.time_source: monotonic tick difference (furi_get_tick / furi_kernel_get_tick_frequency or equivalent), unsigned subtraction tolerates wrap
expected_behaviour.laps: ring of 10, newest first; Up ignored while stopped

assertions.check: States target or provisional baseline (1.5.1/f7/API 88.2) and the unknown installed firmware as a risk
Uses only APIs exported at API 88.2 (furi_get_tick, furi_kernel_get_tick_frequency, furi_timer_*, view_port_*, gui_*); no invented timing API
OK start/stop, Up lap only while running, ring of 10 newest first, long-OK reset only while stopped, short Back exit
Elapsed time from tick difference (not callback counting), wrap-safe, correct mm:ss.cc formatting; manifest has appid, apptype EXTERNAL and entry_point int32_t(void*)

Redraw timer only requests redraw; timer stopped and freed before ViewPort/state are freed; ViewPort disabled and removed from GUI before free; input handed off without blocking; shared state guarded or single-threaded; records closed
Compile/device marked blocked or not-run; host tests of pure logic reported only if actually run; no emulator pass claimed
No SceneManager/ViewDispatcher scaffolding for one screen; no unrelated files or features
Short build/run instructions with pinned SDK selection and UFBT_HOME isolation

critical: use-after-free of timer context or ViewPort in delivered teardown
build_target: reference/h01-stopwatch compiles with ufbt against the pinned 1.5.1 SDK
